reason: The plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness memory/context assistant: it converts useful agent session cases into local Wiki content and optionally promotes repeated workflows into native Skills for later recall, which is a knowledge-management workflow inside the same workspace. Evidence of capability is limited to local persistence, batch scheduling, constrained one-shot background summarization, and read-on-demand recall tools, without external service dependency declared.

summaries.zh: DSH Knowledge Forge 是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识增强插件，可将会话中的关键任务内容沉淀为本地 Wiki，并在重复稳定流程出现时生成可复用 Skill 供后续会话按需检索与调用。
summaries.en: DSH Knowledge Forge is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that distills useful session outcomes into local Wiki records and promotes repeated workflows into reusable Skills for on-demand recall in later sessions.

capabilities: Captures completed top-level agent turns and persists compact records in a project-local SQLite queue/state store.
Generates and stores Markdown Wiki pages and native DSH SKILL.md artifacts for local reuse.
Schedules per-session distillation batches and dead-letter/retry handling.
Provides local recall tools knowledge_search and knowledge_read plus web dashboard and CLI status/doctor/retry commands.

reasons.code: Plugin is described as a local-first Wiki and Skill distillation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, storing data in a local project directory and .dsh/knowledge-forge.sqlite.
README documents session-trigger rules (5 pending turns or 60 minutes), per-session isolation, retries, dead letter, and local markdown/SQLite artifacts.
README and package metadata show DSH client/runtime injection, bundle patch, and CLI entry, indicating host-integrated plugin behavior rather than standalone service.
README lists knowledge_search and knowledge_read tools and an injected compact index used at agent creation time.
Repository structure includes src/tests and plugin-facing assets with manifest/reference files, consistent with executable plugin functionality.
